snapshot.what_it_does: Persistent Systems Limited is a global provider of digital engineering and enterprise modernisation services, specialising in AI-driven solutions and software product engineering for industries such as BFSI, Healthcare and Hi-Tech. It builds software products from conception to deployment, modernises core platforms and embeds AI across operations, supported by proprietary platforms such as SASVA, GenAI Hub, Agent Studio and iAURA.

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Near-term financial promises (FY26 tax rate, margin stance, healthcare recovery) were met with numbers matching filings, but the biggest commitments—$2bn revenue, Nagarro close and synergies—remain unproven, and the deal-close timeline has already slipped once. Credibility is decent on operational calls, untested on the transformational Nagarro claims.

bull.point: FY26 revenue $1,654.4M (+17.4% YoY) and PAT ₹18,651.2M (+33.21%) with 12.65% margin and 29.27% ROCE show profitable scale.
Growth accelerated: revenue YoY rose from 21.8% (Jun-25) to 30.3% (Sep-26); Q2 FY27 $487.6M annualises near $1.95bn, close to $2bn target.
Demand indicators are solid: FY26 ACV $1,780.1M, Q4 ACV $445.1M, 86.99% retention, plus AI platforms SASVA, GenAI Hub, Agent Studio and iAURA.

bear.point: Margins deteriorated fast: op margin fell 16.3% (Mar-26) to 10.0% (Sep-26), EBITDA margin 18.9% to 13.6%, and PAT turned -25.4% YoY.
Nagarro is the swing risk: close slipped from Q4 CY26 to Q4-CY26/Q1-CY27, Austria/Spain approvals pending, with 5-6 months integration and synergies still unproven.
Management’s 16-17% margin aspiration and fading 90bps large-deal drag remain unproven against Q2 FY27 EBIT 15% and reported 10.0% op margin.

watch: Nagarro approvals, close timing, integration costs and first measurable revenue/synergy contribution.
Whether op margin recovers from 10.0% toward 15-17% as the 90bps large-deal drag fades and PAT growth turns positive.
Quarterly run-rate versus ~$500M Q4 FY27 exit / $2bn ±a quarter, backed by ACV/TCV conversion.
